# JAJD Construction

> Family-owned painting, siding, and roofing contractor based in Omaha, Nebraska,
> serving homeowners and businesses across the entire state of Nebraska.
> A licensed and insured general contractor. BBB A+ accredited since 2014.
> Free, no-obligation estimates.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** JAJD Construction (also known as JAJD Painting)
- **Type:** Residential and commercial general contractor (painting is the core trade)
- **Core services:** Interior painting, exterior painting, siding installation & repair,
  roofing (inspections, repairs, full replacements), cabinet refinishing, deck staining,
  pressure washing, remodels, commercial painting and build-outs
- **Location:** Based in Omaha, Nebraska, United States
- **Service area:** All of Nebraska, including Omaha, Lincoln, Bellevue, Papillion,
  Elkhorn, Gretna, La Vista, Fremont, Norfolk, Grand Island, Kearney, and surrounding communities
- **Phone:** (380) 239-5307
- **Email:** jajdconstruction@gmail.com
- **Hours:** Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm
- **Credentials:** BBB A+ accredited since 2014; licensed and insured (general liability
  and workers' compensation); reviewed on Google, BBB, and Thumbtack
- **Pricing:** Free written estimates; transparent fixed quotes

## What makes JAJD different

- Family-owned and locally operated, so customers talk directly to the people doing the work
- Specializes in neighborhood-scale residential jobs (single-room repaints, siding repairs,
  roof replacements), not just large commercial projects
- Written scope of work and fixed pricing before any job starts
- 24-hour response time on estimate requests
